text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking through the central plaza
when I
notice that every student I pass
by is staring at
the ground as if in fear of
something. And the
reason turns out to
be...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what has Kris S been standing there
for all
this time?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
How should I know?! But she's giving off
some
intense vibes... Just be sure not to
make eye
contact!

...Is it a three-headed beast I see before
me? Or
perhaps the great world-eating
serpent?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: I-it's Gimlet!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, it looks to be a petrified eye slotted
into an
aegis. Would it not do you some
good to at least
attempt to conceal that
bloodthirst of yours?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, do you yearn so badly for this
greatest of
duels that you would rattle
the very foundations
of Olympus itself?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The contract... is complete.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My, my! Why the cold shoulder?
Unless... our
roles are actually reversed?
Perhaps you'd make a
better Ares, and I
the one to ravage, rage, and
raze with
abandon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That decision... is yours.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haha! Ahahaha! Fantastic! You do know how to rouse my emotions!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then we've no choice but to settle this once and for all! I'll prove to you that I am the Dark Lord of Destruction!

text_block_list.name: Murmuring Students
text_block_list.text:
What the heck are those two planning to
do?! She
said "duel" a minute ago, but
they're not actually
going to fight, are
they?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Concerned that an actual scrap might be
about to
happen, I chase after them
both. Before long, I
end up at the track.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's resume from where we left off
the other
day, Kris S. Tell me, what does
running mean to
you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It means... completing my duty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Insipid as ever. To me, running is... to
enchant
and intoxicate.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: My legs—they intoxicate the audience, the gods, and even the world itself. That is what it truly means to run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is... your answer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... So we're at odds again. We may
both be
gods of war, but it appears even
our principles
are in conflict.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Then let us resolve this, and see
whose
pride will be the one to be
pulverized!

text_block_list.name: Kris S and Tanino
text_block_list.text: Rrrrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What awaits us at our
destination? Will it
be glory or the
ultimate end? Whichever it may
be... the
moment has come!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The moment of our raison d'être!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Ah, this is magnificent! This
above all is
the true cocktail of disorder,
born of a clash
between gods of war!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What unyielding might... The true heart
of
madness—which distills my very
self—beats on
without end. You, too,
are a brilliantly strong
spirit, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: You are as... chatty... as ever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But your distilled power... is genuine.
The depths
of your aesthetics... are also
without bounds.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. As are the depths of your keen

observation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I have unleashed... my full strength...

text_block_list.name: Kris S and Tanino
text_block_list.text: ...That was a fine bout.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. We're still far from inebriated,
wouldn't
you say? I say we try a slightly
different spirit
next.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Agreed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, they both leave. It seems
as if they
have a unique dynamic, and
one that nobody else
can hope to
understand...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, it's clear that they respect and

acknowledge each other as worthy rivals.
